issues.description: Animal's attribute `name` is specified in the UML/problem statement as type `String`, but the reference solution implements it as `private StringBuilder name;`. This mismatches the required class structure and can confuse students about the expected field type (and mutability) when implementing Animal with getter/setter.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the specification by changing `Animal` to `private String name;`, setting it in the constructor, and updating getName/setName accordingly (or explicitly update the UML/problem statement to allow `StringBuilder`, but `String` is the intended type).
